title: Call for Hosts only from Warangal zone : IEEE Hyderabad Section SAC- Warangal Zonal Student Congress 2026
description:
Call for Hosts only from Warangal zone : SAC IEEE Hyderabad Section - Warangal Zonal Student Congress 2026

IEEE Hyderabad Section - Student Activities Committee (SAC) invites active IEEE Student Branches in the Warangal Zone to apply for hosting the IEEE Hyderabad Section - Warangal Zonal Student Congress 2026.

The IEEE Hyderabad Section - Warangal Zonal Student Congress 2026 is a flagship student gathering designed to unite emerging leaders, innovators, and professionals from across engineering disciplines. This zonal congress is an opportunity to build technical communities, nurture collaboration, and amplify the impact of IEEE within the zone.

Eligibility:
All active IEEE Student Branches under the Warangal Zone of IEEE Hyderabad Section.

Why Host Warangal Zonal Congress?
Elevate your Branch and Campus Profile
Hosting a major congress gives your Branch and institution significant regional prominence - positioning you as a hub of innovation and student leadership.

Strengthen Leadership and Organizational Skills
Planning and executing a congress helps volunteers gain real-world project management, communication, and strategic planning experience — all highly valued in industry and academia.

Expand Professional & Industry Networks
Organizers connect with academia, industry experts, speakers, and IEEE leaders, creating channels for internships, mentorship, and future collaborations.

Promote IEEE Membership & Engagement Growth
Hosting attracts new student members and encourages deeper engagement among existing members by showcasing the value of active involvement.

Contribute to Wider Student Community Impact
Your event will inspire peers to develop technical ideas, exchange knowledge, and take initiative - strengthening the entire IEEE student ecosystem in Warangal.

Build Legacy & Institutional Recognition
Successful delivery of a zonal congress becomes a legacy milestone for your Student Branch, benefiting future cohorts and enhancing your institution’s reputation.

Apply Here:
🔗 https://forms.gle/Gdmy2x3jYDHqSwTw7

Deadline:
📅 14th March, 2026

For Queries:
📧 sac@ieeehyd.org

✨ Let your campus become the hub of innovation and leadership for the Warangal Zone — Step up and host the Warangal Zonal Congress!
